import os
import time
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set up paths
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
TRAIN_FILE = "./input/labels.csv"
TEST_FILE = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "./submission/submission.csv"

print("=" * 60)
print("NYC Taxi Fare Prediction - Final Synthesis Solution")
print("=" * 60)
print()

# Track timing
start_time = time.time()

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_FILE, low_memory=False)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_FILE, low_memory=False)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB)

print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")
print()

# Store test keys
test_keys = test_df["key"].values

# NYC bounding box (conservative bounds to avoid over-filtering)
NYC_LAT_MIN = 38.0
NYC_LAT_MAX = 43.0
NYC_LON_MIN = -76.0
NYC_LON_MAX = -72.0


# Feature engineering function with aligned preprocessing
def engineer_features(df, is_training=True):
    df = df.copy()

    # Handle missing passenger_count consistently
    if "passenger_count" in df.columns:
        df["passenger_count"] = pd.to_numeric(df["passenger_count"], errors="coerce")
        if is_training:
            df["passenger_count"] = df["passenger_count"].fillna(0)
        else:
            df["passenger_count"] = df["passenger_count"].fillna(1)

    # Time features - enhanced
    if "pickup_datetime" in df.columns:
        df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce")
        df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
        df["day_of_week"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
        df["is_weekend"] = (df["day_of_week"] >= 5).astype(int)
        df["is_night"] = ((df["hour"] >= 22) | (df["hour"] < 5)).astype(int)
        df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
        df["day_of_month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
        df["day_of_year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofyear

    # Convert coordinates to floats
    for col in [
        "pickup_latitude",
        "pickup_longitude",
        "dropoff_latitude",
        "dropoff_longitude",
    ]:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

    # Fill missing coordinates with NYC center (same as test)
    # This eliminates the validation/test domain shift
    for col in [
        "pickup_latitude",
        "pickup_longitude",
        "dropoff_latitude",
        "dropoff_longitude",
    ]:
        if df[col].isna().any():
            df[col] = df[col].fillna(40.7128)

    # Filter extreme coordinates for training data ONLY (not test)
    if is_training:
        lat_mask = (
            (df["pickup_latitude"] >= NYC_LAT_MIN)
            & (df["pickup_latitude"] <= NYC_LAT_MAX)
            & (df["dropoff_latitude"] >= NYC_LAT_MIN)
            & (df["dropoff_latitude"] <= NYC_LAT_MAX)
        )
        lon_mask = (
            (df["pickup_longitude"] >= NYC_LON_MIN)
            & (df["pickup_longitude"] <= NYC_LON_MAX)
            & (df["dropoff_longitude"] >= NYC_LON_MIN)
            & (df["dropoff_longitude"] <= NYC_LON_MAX)
        )
        keep_mask = lat_mask & lon_mask
        df = df[keep_mask]
        removed = len(train_df) - len(df)
        if removed > 0:
            print(f"Coordinate filtering removed {removed} samples from training")

    # Clean target if training - clip extreme values instead of filtering
    if is_training and "fare_amount" in df.columns:
        # Keep fare_amount but clip later, don't filter out extreme values
        df["fare_amount"] = df["fare_amount"].clip(lower=0, upper=5000)

    # Distance calculation (Haversine for accuracy)
    lat1 = df["pickup_latitude"].values
    lon1 = df["pickup_longitude"].values
    lat2 = df["dropoff_latitude"].values
    lon2 = df["dropoff_longitude"].values

    R = 6371.0  # Earth's radius in km
    dLat = np.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dLon = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)

    a = (
        np.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2
        + np.cos(np.radians(lat1)) * np.cos(np.radians(lat2)) * np.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2
    )
    c = 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1 - a))

    df["distance_km"] = R * c

    # Additional features
    df["lat_diff"] = lat2 - lat1
    df["lon_diff"] = lon2 - lon1
    df["is_long_trip"] = (df["distance_km"] > 20).astype(int)

    return df


print("Engineering features...")
train_featured = engineer_features(train_df, is_training=True)
test_featured = engineer_features(test_df, is_training=False)

print(f"After cleaning - Training: {len(train_featured)}, Test: {len(test_featured)}")

# Prepare feature columns - NO SCALER for LightGBM
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "hour",
    "day_of_week",
    "is_weekend",
    "is_night",
    "month",
    "day_of_month",
    "day_of_year",
    "distance_km",
    "lat_diff",
    "lon_diff",
    "is_long_trip",
]

# Extract target
X_train = train_featured[feature_cols].values
X_test = test_featured[feature_cols].values

y_train = train_featured["fare_amount"].values
y_train = y_train.clip(0, 5000)  # Clip extreme values

# Train/Val Split (80/20 hold-out for genuine RMSE evaluation)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_tr)}, Validation samples: {len(X_val)}")

# Create LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train model with proper API
print("Training LightGBM model...")
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "verbose": -1,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "max_depth": 12,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=300,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    valid_names=["validation"],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=20, first_metric_only=True)],
)

# Calculate validation RMSE (genuine hold-out evaluation)
print("Computing validation predictions...")
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((y_val - y_val_pred) ** 2))
print(f"\nValidation RMSE (hold-out): {val_rmse:.4f}")
print(f"Best iteration: {model.best_iteration}")

# Generate test predictions
print("Making predictions on test set...")
test_preds = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
test_preds = test_preds.clip(0, 5000)  # Clip predictions

# Create submission DataFrame
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test_keys, "fare_amount": test_preds})

# Sort by key for consistency
submission = submission.sort_values("key").reset_index(drop=True)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {OUTPUT_FILE}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Sample predictions:\n{submission.head()}")

# Final timing
end_time = time.time()
print(f"\nTotal runtime: {end_time - start_time:.2f} seconds")
print("=" * 60)
